headline: This is a pretty key insight. Services businesses are always held back by their ability to deliver outcomes to customers. That scaling essentially only could come from headcount, and no matter how much demand you saw, there was always a finite amount of talent you could get for the problem you were going after. Not to mention, the customer generally always wants the work done faster, at a lower price, or at a higher quality. Agents entirely change the calculus here, because now we can scale output in a way that’s decoupled from the among of time that goes in. A single engineer can have the output of dozens of engineers before. A single designer can probably build out your entire design system and brand. And so on. Well why isn’t this just all agents then? Because the key is to still have experts on the front end that actually can ensure the right outcomes are delivered from agents. It’s likely that we’re going to see this in a wide variety of categories. You’ll see this in cyber security, advertising and marketing, legal, accounting, IT transformation, and a number of other historically people-only services industries. It’s a great time if you’re starting one of these businesses, or if you have the capability to transform an existing one.

headline: Edge AI Daily 早报（11月24日）
abstract: 本期核心情报由三条主线构成。其一，英伟达董事会于11月23日一致恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO及董事职务，股价日内大涨逾30%、纳指与标普同步反弹，特朗普公开背书称不构成国家安全风险；公司同步设立国家安全与出口管制监督委员会并启动首席合规官招聘，但独立调查、国会12月3日听证及Megaspeed实体清单风险未消，涨势被定性为治理溢价修复而非业绩验证，AI芯片出口管制正由货物流向转向远程算力访问与终端用户识别。其二，谷歌DeepMind与量子AI以Gemini 4智能体协同搜索、Lean验证重写量子算法，聚变与光化学模拟获优化但未及商业化；谷歌同时将Drive、Wallet、Gemini接入搜索AI Mode，搜索竞争焦点转向生态数据关系。其三，模型经济学加速转向：OpenAI以困惑度、交叉熵为能力与安全共同尺度并倡议行业限速，甲骨文完成OpenAI合同融资，Anthropic千亿募资对应约9000亿算力承诺、债券大概率落于BB区间，Arm续约至2033年锚定软银AI底座，马斯克警告明年算力投入或面临数千亿营运资金缺口。开源侧，记忆张量联合英伟达开源554B记忆原生模型MemT-1.0-Pro，Thinking Machines发布26.4B循环Transformer模型Inkling 2 Mini，开放模型竞争由参数规模转向有效计算与部署效率。
